title: CSF Patterns by Aetiology
description: Flip each card to review the characteristic CSF findings. Try to recall the pattern before flipping.

dialogs.answer: Turbid/cloudy CSF; neutrophilic (PMNL) pleocytosis (>1000 cells/mm³); very low glucose (<40% of blood glucose); very high protein (>1 g/L)

tips.front: Purulent = polymorphs + protein up + glucose down

dialogs.answer: Clear CSF; lymphocytic pleocytosis (10–500 cells/mm³); normal glucose; mildly raised protein (0.5–1 g/L)
Clear or xanthochromic CSF; lymphocytic pleocytosis (50–500 cells/mm³); very low glucose; very high protein; characteristic cobweb clot on standing

tips.front: TBM mimics bacterial biochemistry (low glucose, high protein) but with lymphocytes

dialogs.answer: Clear CSF; lymphocytic pleocytosis; low glucose; India ink preparation positive (budding yeast with halo) or cryptococcal antigen (CrAg) positive

tips.front: Suspect in immunocompromised patients, especially HIV/AIDS
